developer.text: DermaSensor Inc. (founders include Dr. Maurice Ferre and Christopher Dewey). Company history describes development of Elastic Scattering Spectroscopy (ESS) and a proprietary machine learning algorithm trained on histopathology-confirmed lesions.

availability.text: FDA-cleared and available for sale in the U.S.; CE marked; waitlist/limited state availability described publicly.

summary.text: Connected handheld device intended to help frontline providers assess lesions suspicious for melanoma/BCC/SCC and inform referral decisions, producing results in seconds.

medical_purpose.text: Identified suspicious lesion is scanned with five spectral recordings; algorithm returns “Investigate Further” or “Monitor,” with a 1–10 similarity score for malignancy patterns. Intended for use alongside clinician assessment and not as a screening tool or sole diagnostic criterion.

acceptable_input.text: Spectral recordings from the scanned lesion.
Input: spectral signal; Output: categorical result + numeric score intended to guide referral decisions.
Three-step process (identify lesion → apply device/record spectra → receive result). Instructional materials and device instructions for use are referenced by the developer.

output.text: Output includes referral-oriented risk classification and score; intended to improve triage and reduce missed cancers by clinicians in reader studies.

role_in_decision_making.text: Potential harms relate to missed malignancy (false negative) or unnecessary escalation (false positive); intended as adjunctive decision support with clinician oversight.

intended_users.text: Qualified healthcare professionals in clinical settings; marketed for non-dermatology providers in primary care and related outpatient settings.
Clinical assessment skills for lesion selection and interpretation; device is an adjunct to clinical judgment.

target_patient_population.text: Patients (often 40+) with lesions already judged suspicious for melanoma/BCC/SCC where a referral decision is being considered.

known_failure_modes.text: Performance depends on appropriate lesion selection and workflow context; false negatives/positives possible; study performance may not generalize across settings.

Pivotal trial demographics and post-market testing requirements for underrepresented populations are discussed in external analysis; details of training set diversity are not fully disclosed publicly.

unsupported_clinical_scenarios.text: Use only with totality of clinically relevant information; not a screening tool; not sole diagnostic criterion; false negatives may delay cancer treatment and false positives may lead to unnecessary referrals/procedures; see instructions for use for full risk list.

ESS spectroscopy captures wavelength-dependent backscatter; preprocessing + proprietary neural network compares pattern against training data from histopathology-confirmed lesions; returns risk output to aid referral decisions.

clinical_trial.text: Study evidence and summaries described in the clinical evidence PDF.

performance.summary.text: Public materials and study summaries report no device-related safety issues; primary safety concerns are clinical consequences of false results.
Human-in-the-loop clinical judgment remains required; device should be used only as intended.
